hook: A 2014 iPhone 6 Plus now boots iOS 15.

beats.say: Apple stopped the iPhone 6 Plus at iOS 12. Celestial's open-source n56-patcher already got it running iOS 13.7 and 14.8.
Now it reaches iOS 15.8.8, installed on its own separate volumes right next to the original system, so the old iOS stays put.
On real hardware, Wi-Fi, audio, camera, Bluetooth, cellular and Health are reported working, on a phone that's twelve years old.
